authors.bio: Experienced fractional CTO specializing in RIA and wealth-management firms. Helping firms using Orion, Redtail, Wealthbox or eMoney stacks manage security, integrations, and vendor risks.

editorial.testing: We test and evaluate wealth-management software, integrations, and security practices objectively. Our insights are based on hands-on experience operating production environments for RIAs.
editorial.monetization: AdvisorCTO makes money exclusively through monthly retainers and fixed-scope consulting engagements. We do not accept referral fees, kickbacks, or affiliate commissions from any vendor, ensuring our advice remains entirely independent.
editorial.corrections: If we discover an inaccuracy in our technical advice or vendor assessments, we update the content and note the correction at the bottom of the affected page.
